svg.title: Community and optional Cloud hosting management
svg.desc: The Community host implements tenant content and a separate host administration API. Cloud hosting orchestration, local start and move flows, and optional shared sign-in are planned paths at this snapshot. Cloud management does not access messages, files or the host database.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:

Agents execute here
